name: Magmatoad
lore: It basks in the lava as other toads bask on stone. Its croak carries sulphur and its bite carries fire.
prompt: Fat fantasy toad of cooled black rock with glowing orange cracks, bulging ember eyes, a wide mouth breathing a wisp of smoke, and a hot glowing throat sac, no drop shadow on the ground.
